Use of Biological Resources appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The Edexcel IGCSE board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Use of Biological Resources.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
